main.description: Re-process an existing intake through the LangGraph processor (extract_facts / expand_todo / summarize / defer_for_user_review). Used to upgrade a prior artifact with a stronger model, or to change processor kind. Writes a new vertex_manimani_artifact (does not mutate prior artifacts). Per ADR-2605080800.

forceProcessor.description: Override the project.kind-derived processor. When omitted, uses the project's current kind.

modelTier.description: LLM tier override. Default is the kind-default (fast for memo/summarize, balanced for knowledge/task).

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: Required field missing or processor mismatch with project kind.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: intakeId not found in actor scope.
